summary: Stone Point Credit Corporation filed an 8-K to report a quarterly dividend of $0.430 per share declared on June 26, 2026, payable June 30 to holders of record June 29. The distribution yields an annualized 8.8% based on net asset value. This is a routine capital return to shareholders, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activism, or restructuring is involved. The filing merely updates a standard recurring distribution; nothing event-driven or structural beyond ordinary course.
